rows.name: Precision
rows.tooltip: Each stack adds 1 Accuracy.

rows.name: Evade
rows.tooltip: Each stack adds 3 Evasion. Lose 1 stack at the start of each round.

rows.name: Strength
rows.tooltip: Attacks deal +1 damage per stack.

rows.name: Dexterity
rows.tooltip: Cards grant +1 Block per stack.

rows.name: Weak
rows.tooltip: Deals 25% less attack damage. 1 stack expires each turn.

rows.name: Vulnerable
rows.tooltip: Takes 25% more attack damage. 1 stack expires each turn.

rows.name: Frail
rows.tooltip: Gains 25% less Block from cards. 1 stack expires each turn.

rows.name: Bleed
rows.tooltip: Build-up: points do not decay. At {proc.threshold}, burst for {proc.burstPercent}% of max HP (min {proc.burstMin}, max {proc.burstMax}), ignoring Block, plus {proc.poiseDamage} Poise damage — then the build-up resets to zero. Fleshy targets briefly resist further Bleed after a burst.

rows.name: Frost
rows.tooltip: Build-up: points do not decay. At {proc.threshold}, burst for {proc.burstPercent}% of max HP (min {proc.burstMin}, max {proc.burstMax}), ignoring Block, and the target is left Weak and Frost-Exposed — then the build-up resets to zero.

rows.name: Insanity
rows.tooltip: Build-up: points do not decay. At {proc.threshold}, burst for {proc.burstPercent}% of max HP (min {proc.burstMin}, max {proc.burstMax}), ignoring Block, with {proc.poiseDamage} Poise damage and a guaranteed Stagger — then the build-up resets to zero.

rows.name: Clotted
rows.tooltip: Just burst — hardened against Bleed: incoming build-up reduced {resists.percent}% for {decay.duration} turns.

rows.name: Weathered
rows.tooltip: Just burst — hardened against Frost: incoming build-up reduced {resists.percent}% for {decay.duration} turns.

rows.name: Resolute
rows.tooltip: Just burst — hardened against Insanity: incoming build-up reduced {resists.percent}% for {decay.duration} turns.

rows.name: Frost-Exposed
rows.tooltip: Takes {tv.pct}% more damage from starstone attacks. Stacks with Vulnerable. {decay.duration} turns.

rows.name: Unraveled
rows.tooltip: Takes {tv.pct}% more damage from ritual and blight attacks. Stacks with Vulnerable. {decay.duration} turns.

rows.name: Crimson Blight
rows.tooltip: At the start of its turn, loses HP equal to Blight stacks (ignores Block). Stacks do not tick down; the Blight expires entirely after 3 turns. Re-applying adds stacks and refreshes the duration.

rows.name: Necrotic Blight
rows.tooltip: At the start of its turn, loses HP equal to Necrotic Blight stacks (ignores Block). Applied by Necrotic damage. Stacks do not tick down and it lasts the whole fight; only a cleanse removes it.

rows.name: Burn
rows.tooltip: At the start of its turn, loses HP equal to Burn stacks (ignores Block). One stack burns out each turn.

rows.name: Regen
rows.tooltip: At the start of its turn, heals HP equal to Regen stacks. Lasts the whole fight.

rows.name: Madness
rows.tooltip: At the start of your turn: lose 2 HP per stack, gain 1 Energy per stack, then Madness clears.

rows.name: Staggered
rows.tooltip: Poise broken: skips its next turn and takes 50% more attack damage until the end of your next turn.

rows.name: Rallying Standard
rows.tooltip: At the start of your turn: gain 1 Strength and take 1 damage (per stack).

rows.name: Rallying Standard+
rows.tooltip: At the start of your turn: gain 1 Strength (per stack).

rows.name: Unbreakable
rows.tooltip: Block no longer expires at the start of your turn. Block is capped at 30.

rows.name: Unbreakable+
rows.tooltip: Block no longer expires at the start of your turn. Block is capped at 40.

rows.name: Goreblood
rows.tooltip: Poise thresholds no longer increase after filling.

rows.name: Sanguine Pact
rows.tooltip: Whenever Bleed bursts on an enemy, gain 2 Strength per stack.

rows.name: Starstone Charge
rows.tooltip: A spell was cast this turn: your next Starstone bonus is live. Fades at end of turn.

rows.name: Stargazer
rows.tooltip: At the start of your turn, gain Starstone Charge.

rows.name: Astral Armor
rows.tooltip: At the end of your turn, gain 4 Block per stack.

rows.name: Constellation
rows.tooltip: Whenever you gain Starstone Charge, deal 4 damage per stack to a random enemy.

rows.name: Azure Coil
rows.tooltip: Whenever you play a Skill, gain 2 Block per stack.

rows.name: Waxing Moon
rows.tooltip: At the start of your turn, apply 2 Vulnerable to ALL enemies per stack.

rows.name: Moonlit Shield
rows.tooltip: Whenever you gain Starstone Charge, gain 3 Block per stack.

rows.name: Astromancer
rows.tooltip: At the start of your turn, gain Starstone Charge and draw a card.

rows.name: Thorn Halo
rows.tooltip: At the start of your turn, apply 1 Crimson Blight per stack to ALL enemies.

rows.name: Communion
rows.tooltip: At the start of your turn, heal 3 HP per stack.

rows.name: Life Tithe
rows.tooltip: Whenever an enemy dies, heal 8 HP per stack.

rows.name: Stigmata
rows.tooltip: Whenever you lose HP, heal 2 HP per stack.

rows.name: Zealotry
rows.tooltip: Whenever you lose HP, deal 3 damage to a random enemy per stack.

rows.name: Ember Tide
rows.tooltip: Whenever you heal, gain 1 Strength per stack.

rows.name: Harbinger of Blight
rows.tooltip: Whenever you apply Blight (Crimson or Necrotic) to an enemy, heal 1 HP per stack.

rows.name: Blood Unction
rows.tooltip: Your attacks apply 2 extra Bleed per hit this turn.

rows.name: Iron Vow
rows.tooltip: Whenever you lose HP, gain 3 Block per stack.

rows.name: Shieldwall Echo
rows.tooltip: At the start of your next turn: gain 4 Block per stack.

rows.name: Prepared
rows.tooltip: Your next setup payoff is empowered. Expires at turn end.

rows.name: Venom
rows.tooltip: At turn start, lose HP equal to Venom. 1 stack expires each turn.

rows.name: Afterimage
rows.tooltip: Every third card played each combat grants 3 Block per stack.

rows.name: Deadly Tempo
rows.tooltip: At turn start, become Prepared and draw 1 card per stack.

rows.name: Opportunist
rows.tooltip: When an enemy staggers, become Prepared and draw 1 card per stack.

rows.name: Envenom
rows.tooltip: Your attacks apply 1 Venom per stack.

rows.name: Glass Cannon
rows.tooltip: Deal 25% more attack damage, and take 25% more.

rows.name: Magic Vulnerable
rows.tooltip: Magic-school HP damage is increased while this lasts.

rows.name: Stance Shifted
rows.tooltip: You have entered a stance this fight: Oath cards no longer grant Block.

rows.name: Silenced
rows.tooltip: Spells cost 1 more Stamina per stack. Immune to Force: each Force hit or effect is stopped and removes 1 stack.

rows.name: Stoneskin
rows.tooltip: Your Block is not removed at the start of your next turn.

rows.name: Bleeding
rows.tooltip: Lose 1 HP per stack at turn start. Bodily Chance Recovery.

rows.name: Frozen
rows.tooltip: One stack denies one Action. Fire thaws; Blunt shatters. Elemental Chance Recovery.

rows.name: Chilled
rows.tooltip: The next connected Blunt action deals 25% more damage. Fire thaws.

rows.name: Sleep
rows.tooltip: Locks ordinary cards, Counter and card Evade. Rest restores up to 6 HP and 1 Ward per combat. +10% direct damage received per active stack. Break Sleep: 2 SP per stack.

rows.name: Paralysis
rows.tooltip: Locks ordinary cards, Counter and card Evade. Break Paralysis: 3 SP per stack. Grounding clears its pressure.

rows.name: Dazed
rows.tooltip: Locks ordinary cards, Counter and card Evade. Clear Dazed: 1 SP per stack.

rows.name: Off Balance
rows.tooltip: Disadvantage on bodily recovery. One stack expires at turn end.

rows.name: Prone
rows.tooltip: +25% Contact damage, −25% Single Near/Far damage. +2/+4 Evade against Near/Far Martial weapons. Stand Up: 1 SP after hand locks clear.

rows.name: Grounded
rows.tooltip: Prevents electrical conductivity and backlash; grants Advantage on Paralysis recovery.

rows.name: Invulnerability
rows.tooltip: Consume one stack to avoid the next direct damaging action, including all its hits. Status buildup still applies; no Counter return. Damage over time does not consume it.

rows.name: Decoy
rows.tooltip: Consume one stack to avoid a Single Near/Far damaging action. Status buildup still applies. Sweep and Holy revelation clear it.

rows.name: Concealed
rows.tooltip: Concealment. Sweep and Holy revelation clear it.

rows.name: Confused
rows.tooltip: Deals 10% less damage. At the start of its turn, 50% chance to take 3 Poise damage per stack. 1 stack expires each turn.

rows.name: Slowed
rows.tooltip: Deals 10% less damage and gains 25% less Block. 1 stack expires each turn.

rows.name: Entombed
rows.tooltip: Skips its next turn. Takes 25% less damage while entombed.

rows.name: Persistent Block
rows.tooltip: Replenish Block up to remaining stacks at turn start. A connected physical hit consumes one stack, including fully blocked hits.

rows.name: Persistent Barrier
rows.tooltip: Replenish Barrier up to remaining stacks at turn start. A connected magical hit consumes one stack, including fully protected hits.

rows.name: Greased
rows.tooltip: Melee/Reach accuracy -20. At turn start 25% chance to become Prone. Fire cannot miss: triple damage, Burn 3, and splash 1.5 times the original incoming fire damage to other same-side actors.

rows.name: Poison
rows.tooltip: At turn start take 1 necrotic damage per stack. Unlike Venom, this is direct ongoing damage, without a buildup threshold. Lose one stack at turn end.

rows.name: Blight
rows.tooltip: If Blight stacks reach current HP, die immediately. Lose one stack at turn end.

rows.name: Weak
rows.tooltip: Deal 25% less direct damage while active. Additional stacks extend duration; they do not multiply the penalty.

rows.name: Charm
rows.tooltip: Direct attack accuracy -25 while active. Lose one stack at turn end.

rows.name: Bind
rows.tooltip: Cannot play Attack cards. Skill, Power and recovery cards remain available. Lose one stack at turn end.

rows.name: Restrained
rows.tooltip: Melee and Reach cards cost 1 extra Stamina while active. This is separate from a generated Restrained burden card.

rows.name: Foresight
rows.tooltip: Each stack grants +2 Perception for detecting Veil. Lose one stack at the next turn start.

rows.name: Evade
rows.tooltip: Consume one stack when a direct physical hit is attempted: 25% chance to avoid the entire action. Failed attempts also consume the stack.

rows.name: Intangible
rows.tooltip: Direct hit damage is capped at 1; ongoing damage is unaffected. Lose one stack at the next turn start.

rows.name: Mirrors
rows.tooltip: Double direct outgoing damage. Additional stacks extend duration, without exponential multiplication. Lose one stack at the next turn start.

rows.name: Elemental Weapon
rows.tooltip: Weapon attacks add a separate 3 Fire damage packet. The packet does not recursively trigger enchantments or reactions.

rows.name: Necrotic Renewal
rows.tooltip: Incoming necrotic damage becomes equal healing, before protection. Lose one stack at the next turn start.

rows.name: Profane Inversion
rows.tooltip: Incoming Divine healing becomes equal Sacred damage. Ordinary healing is unchanged. Lose one stack at turn end.

rows.name: Extra Weapon
rows.tooltip: The next weapon Attack repeats its primary damage once, without repeating card payment or recursively creating another action.

rows.name: Extra Shield
rows.tooltip: The next shield/guard card repeats its protection once, without repeating payment or reactions.

rows.name: Automatic Counter
rows.tooltip: After a hostile direct Melee/Reach hit connects, consume a stack and return 6 physical damage. Reaction damage cannot trigger another automatic reaction.

rows.name: Automatic Sweep
rows.tooltip: After a hostile direct hit connects, consume a stack and deal 4 physical damage to each opposing actor. Reaction damage cannot recurse.

rows.name: Reflect
rows.tooltip: Reflect half actual HP damage from hostile direct hits, rounded down. Reflected damage never reflects again.

rows.name: Interpose
rows.tooltip: Intercept up to 4 direct damage per stack for another ally, consuming one stack per interception. The lowest actor ID wins competing guards.

rows.name: Veil
rows.tooltip: Single-target actions must detect the bearer. Chance is 50% plus 5% per Perception advantage, minus 10% per Veil stack, clamped to 5–95%. Area actions bypass Veil.

rows.name: Hold Block
rows.tooltip: Retain up to 4 existing Block per stack when Block would expire. This does not create protection or duplicate Persistent Block.

rows.name: Read Intent
rows.tooltip: Marks a targeted Read Intent. The read belongs to its owner and selected enemy. Lose one stack at the next turn start.

rows.name: Stagger
rows.tooltip: Visible burden tracking only. The generated card owns its action loss or resource tax, so this marker never applies it twice.

rows.name: Paralysis
rows.tooltip: Visible burden tracking only. The generated card owns its action loss or resource tax, so this marker never applies it twice.

rows.name: Restrained Burden
rows.tooltip: Visible burden tracking only. The generated card owns its action loss or resource tax, so this marker never applies it twice.

rows.name: Many Forms
rows.tooltip: Each stack permits one additional concurrent stance. One stack allows two total stances. Lose one stack at the next turn start.

rows.name: Conceal
rows.tooltip: Each stack increases cards hidden and their hidden duration by one. Lose one stack at owner turn start.
